failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'Did Craig Heyer play sports at a college located in Clark County, Nevada (other than any community colleges)?' - This is formulated as a natural-language yes/no question rather than a structured entity-targeting query.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 query: 'Which college did Craig Heyer play sports at, and is that college located in Clark County, Nevada?' - This is a compound multi-part question bundling two separate targets (which college + location verification) rather than a focused entity query.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: All three hops retrieved the same Craig Heyer passage stating he 'played college baseball at the College of Southern Nevada and University of Nevada, Las Vegas (UNLV)'. Hop 2 and Hop 3 queries both ask essentially the same question about which college Craig Heyer attended in Clark County, producing redundant retrieval results without advancing the investigation.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 solver reasoning extensively processes passages about Clark State Community College (Springfield, Ohio), NAIA independent football schools, Jones County Junior College (Mississippi), and Great Basin College (Elko, Nevada) - all clearly irrelevant to the claim about Clark County, Nevada - rather than focusing solely on the relevant Craig Heyer and College of Southern Nevada passages.
